body:
Fixes <https://qelectrotech.org/bugtracker/view.php?id=243>.

## The problem

Opening an element you cannot write — anything from the QET collection, for instance — disables **Copy** along with everything else, so there is no way to reuse a primitive from it. The reporter's workaround was to save the whole element into their own collection first, just to take one shape out of it.

## Cause

Two actions stood in the way in `QETElementEditor::updateAction()`, and neither of them modifies anything:

- **Select All** and **Invert Selection** were in the list disabled outright when read only, so nothing could be selected in the first place;
- **Copy** was enabled only when `!m_read_only && selectedItems().count()`, so even a mouse selection left it greyed out.

## The fix

Both now work on a read-only element. Copy is safe there: `ElementScene::copy()` serialises the current selection to the clipboard and touches neither the element nor the file.

**Cut, Paste, Paste-in-area, Delete, Rotate, Fine-Rotate, Flip, Mirror, the depth actions and the add-primitive tools all stay disabled exactly as before.** This only stops the editor refusing to read out what it is already displaying on screen.

## Testing

With a `chmod 444` element (title bar shows `[lecture seule]`):

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| Tout sélectionner | greyed | **enabled** |
| Inverser la sélection | greyed | **enabled** |
| Copier (with a selection) | greyed | **enabled** |
| Couper / Coller / Coller dans la zone | greyed | greyed |
| Supprimer / Rotation / Mirror | greyed | greyed |
| Enregistrer | greyed | greyed |

After Select All → Copy, the clipboard contains the expected element description:

```xml
<definition type="element" link_type="simple" ... >
    <names><name lang="en">ReadOnly copy test</name></names>
    <description>
        <rect .../>
        <line .../>
        <circle .../>
    </description>
</definition>
```

— ready to paste into an element of your own. The source file is untouched afterwards: same permissions (`-r--r--r--`), same checksum.

Built against Qt 5.15, Release, no new warnings.
